item.case_name: Text on screen in a clip
item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Gardener Interview Name Caption

turns.text: Make a silent 7-second widescreen clip of a fictional woman standing in a community garden, smiling and turning slightly toward the camera. Put “Maya Chen” with “Community Gardener” underneath at the bottom left from second 1 through the end. White lettering on a dark backing, not over her face. No other text.

item.tests: Checks an exact two-line lower third that stays readable and correctly placed over a moving subject.

answer_sheet.Person and setting: A fictional woman in a community garden; her appearance is your call.
answer_sheet.Name and role: Maya Chen on the first line; Community Gardener underneath. English, without quotation marks.
answer_sheet.Caption appearance and timing: Bottom left, white lettering on a dark backing, clear of her face, appearing at second 1 and staying through the end.
answer_sheet.Mood and movement: Friendly and natural; she smiles and turns slightly toward the camera.

must_haves: A woman is visibly in a community garden, smiling and turning slightly toward the camera.
The lower third reads exactly 'Maya Chen' above 'Community Gardener', with no additional text.
Both lines use legible white lettering on a dark backing at the bottom left, with no clipping.
The lower third does not cover her face and remains stable and readable as she moves.
The caption is absent during the opening second and present from approximately second 1 through the end.
The delivered clip is silent, 9:16 and approximately 7 seconds long.
After the follow-up, the final result is vertical 9:16 (the user changed the shape from widescreen 16:9); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it vertical, for stories, and keep everything else the same.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a silent, photorealistic 7-second widescreen 16:9 video in a community garden. One fictional adult woman, Maya Chen, stands among raised vegetable beds and flowers in soft natural daylight, wearing casual gardening clothes. Medium waist-up composition, woman positioned in the center-right so the bottom-left is clear of her face and body. She smiles warmly and slowly turns slightly toward the camera. Gentle natural movement, anatomically consistent, steady locked-off camera, one continuous shot, no cuts. REQUIRED LOWER-THIRD GRAPHIC: From 0.0 to just before 1.0 seconds, no text. At exactly 1.0 seconds, display a stable dark charcoal rectangular backing at the bottom left, within safe margins. On this backing display exactly two lines of crisp white sans-serif lettering, left aligned: first line 'Maya Chen', second line underneath 'Community Gardener'. Name line larger than role line. Keep both lines fully legible, spelled exactly as specified, stationary and continuously visible from 1.0 seconds through the final frame at 7.0 seconds. Graphic must never cover her face. No other text anywhere: no titles, captions, logos, watermarks, labels, signs or credits. No speech, no music, no ambient sounds; completely silent output.

style.prompt: A silent 7-second vertical 9:16 Stories video, photorealistic. A fictional adult woman stands in a beautiful community garden among raised vegetable beds and flowers in soft natural daylight. Casual gardening clothes. She smiles warmly and slowly turns slightly toward the camera. Steady locked-off camera, single continuous medium waist-up shot, natural gentle motion. Frame her center-right with ample space bottom left for a lower-third, never over her face. TEXT TIMING AND DESIGN: For the first second (0 to 1 seconds), no text. At 1 second a dark charcoal rectangular lower-third backing appears at the bottom left within Stories-safe margins, with exactly two left-aligned lines of white sans-serif text: 'Maya Chen' on the first line, and 'Community Gardener' underneath in smaller lettering. The exact correctly spelled two-line graphic stays stationary and fully visible from second 1 through the final frame at second 7. Keep it away from her face. No other text, signs, labels, logos or credits. Completely silent: no dialogue, music or ambient sound.
